Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu
Before running any of the following code, set the experiment name in line 18. This should be the name of the folder that the key (.csv file) and monitor (.txt) files are located.
Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
```
Set Experiment name and start time
```{r,define experiment}
# Define the active experiment name
experiment_name <- "DAMdev0"
cutoff_datetime <- ymd_hms("2023-11-04 16:00:00")#nothing eclosed before now
```
Load in data and aggregate the activity counts by minute, remove data prior to first eclosion and save to "output" folder.
```{r,counts by minute}
# Source the aggregate counts R script
source("scripts/aggregate_count_data.R")
# Call the function from the external script with the experiment name
result <- aggregate_counts(paste("data/", experiment_name, sep = ""), aggregation_level = "minute")
# Specify the metadata file name using the experiment name
metadata_file <- paste("data/", experiment_name, "/key.csv", sep = "")
# Load the metadata and combine with the aggregate data
metadata_df <- read.csv(metadata_file)
merged_df <- merge(result, metadata_df, by = c("Tube", "Monitor"), all.x = FALSE)
activity_minutes <- merged_df %>%
  filter(Minute < cutoff_datetime) 
```
Determining which tubes had any movement at all
```{r}
# Determining the first instance of non-zero Summary_Ct for each Tube and Monitor, sorted by Minute
movement <- distinct(activity_minutes %>%
  group_by(Tube, Monitor) %>%
  summarise(
    Tube=Tube,
    Monitor=Monitor,
    Notes=Notes,
    Geno=Geno,
    Sex=Sex,
    treatLarvae=treatLarvae,
    Total_Ct = sum(Summary_Ct)))
output_file <- paste("output/", experiment_name, "_total_counts.csv", sep = "")
# Save the filtered and aggregated data to a CSV file
# Specify the assayer file name using the experiment name
metadata_file <- paste("data/", experiment_name, "/key_assayer.csv", sep = "")
# Load the metadata and combine with the aggregate data
assayer <- read.csv(metadata_file)
movement<-merge(movement,assayer,by=c("Monitor"))
write.csv(movement, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
```
Looking at Dead Tubes by assayer, Monitor, Geno and Treatment
```{r}
# Filter for just absence or presence of movement
note_counts_binary <- movement %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Notes == "no pupae or larvae detected", "No Pupae", "Other"))

# Count the number of tubes in each category for each Monitor
note_counts_by_monitor <- note_counts_binary %>%
  group_by(Monitor, Category) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Count the number of tubes in each category for each assayer
note_counts_by_assayer <- note_counts_binary %>%
  group_by(Assayer, Category) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Assayer) %>%
  mutate(Total_Count = sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()
note_counts_by_assayer$percentage<-note_counts_by_assayer$Count/note_counts_by_assayer$Total_Count
# Count the number of tubes in each category for each genotype
note_counts_by_geno <- note_counts_binary %>%
  group_by(Geno, Category) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Geno) %>%
  mutate(Total_Count = sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()
note_counts_by_geno$percentage<-note_counts_by_geno$Count/note_counts_by_geno$Total_Count
# Count the number of tubes in each category for each treatment
note_counts_by_treat <- note_counts_binary %>%
  group_by(treatLarvae, Category) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(treatLarvae) %>%
  mutate(Total_Count = sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()
note_counts_by_treat$percentage<-note_counts_by_treat$Count/note_counts_by_treat$Total_Count
```
Plots of dead tubes
```{r}
# Install and load the gridExtra package if you haven't already
install.packages("gridExtra")
library(gridExtra)

# Create the four bar plots
plot1 <- ggplot(note_counts_for_plots, aes(x = factor(Monitor), y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Monitor", y = "Number of Tubes", title = "Number of dead Tubes by Monitor") +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Notes") +
  theme_minimal()

plot2 <- ggplot(note_counts_by_assayer, aes(x = factor(Assayer), y = percentage, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Assayer", y = "Number of Tubes", title = "Number of dead tubes by Assayer") +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Notes") +
  theme_minimal()

plot3 <- ggplot(note_counts_by_geno, aes(x = factor(Geno), y = percentage, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Geno", y = "Number of Tubes", title = "Number of dead tubes by Genotype") +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Notes") +
  theme_minimal()

plot4 <- ggplot(note_counts_by_treat, aes(x = factor(treatLarvae), y = percentage, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "treatLarvae", y = "Number of Tubes", title = "Number of dead tubes by Treatment") +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "Notes") +
  theme_minimal()

# Arrange the plots in a 4x4 grid
grid_arrange <- grid.arrange(plot1, plot2, plot3, plot4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

# Save the grid as an image (e.g., PNG)
ggsave("bar_plots_grid.png", grid_arrange, width = 10, height = 10)

```

Looking at Dead Tubes by Sex, Geno and Treatment
```{r}
# Filter for just absence or presence of movement
note_counts_binary <- movement %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Notes == "no pupae or larvae detected", "No Pupae", "Other"))

# Count the number of tubes in each category for each Sex,Geno, Treatment Combo
note_counts_by_group <- note_counts_binary %>%
  group_by(Geno, treatLarvae, Category, Sex) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup()

# Pivot the table to have counts for each Sex in separate columns
note_counts_by_group <- pivot_wider(note_counts_by_group, 
                                    names_from = Sex, 
                                    values_from = n, 
                                    values_fill = 0)
note_counts_by_group$SexRatio<-note_counts_by_group$M/note_counts_by_group$F

# Count the number of tubes in each category for each assayer
note_counts_by_assayer <- note_counts_binary %>%
  group_by(Assayer, Category) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Assayer) %>%
  mutate(Total_Count = sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()
note_counts_by_assayer$percentage<-note_counts_by_assayer$Count/note_counts_by_assayer$Total_Count
# Count the number of tubes in each category for each genotype
note_counts_by_geno <- note_counts_binary %>%
  group_by(Geno, Category) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Geno) %>%
  mutate(Total_Count = sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()
note_counts_by_geno$percentage<-note_counts_by_geno$Count/note_counts_by_geno$Total_Count
# Count the number of tubes in each category for each treatment
note_counts_by_treat <- note_counts_binary %>%
  group_by(treatLarvae, Category) %>%

  ungroup() %>%

note_counts_by_treat$percentage<-note_counts_by_treat$Count/note_counts_by_treat$Total_Count
```

Determining the first time point at which each tube had movement
```{r,first movement}
# Determining the first instance of non-zero Summary_Ct for each Tube and Monitor, sorted by Minute
first_non_zero <- activity_minutes %>%
  arrange(Minute) %>% # Sort by Minute
  group_by(Tube, Monitor) %>%
  filter(Summary_Ct != 0) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
output_file <- paste("output/", experiment_name, "_total_counts.csv", sep = "")
# Save the filtered and aggregated data to a CSV file
write.csv(activity_minutes, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
```
Determining which tubes had no movement
```{r}
# Create a dataframe with all tubes
all_tubes <- unique(activity_minutes[, c("Monitor", "Tube")])
# Use anti_join to find tubes not included in first_non_zero
no_movement <- anti_join(all_tubes, first_non_zero, by = c("Monitor", "Tube"))
# Subset the activity_minutes dataframe for those that have no movement
subset_activity_minutes <- activity_minutes %>%
  semi_join(no_movement, by = c("Monitor", "Tube"))
```





```{r,}
# Filter rows based on the "Notes" column, removing sex info that is NA
first_non_zero <- first_non_zero %>%
  filter(!grepl("NA", Sex, ignore.case = TRUE))
# Add the experiment name as the first column
first_non_zero <- first_non_zero %>%
  mutate(Experiment = experiment_name)
# Reorder columns with Experiment as the first column
first_non_zero <- first_non_zero %>%
  dplyr::select(Experiment, everything())
# Specify the output file name using the experiment name
output_file <- paste("output/", experiment_name, "_first_non_zero.csv", sep = "")
# Save the filtered and aggregated data to a CSV file
write.csv(first_non_zero, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
```
